mapper.insert: insert into department(name, create_time, update_time) values(#{name}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update department set name = #{name}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, name, create_time, update_time from department order by update_time desc
select id, name, create_time, update_time from department where id = #{id}
